plugins.name: guedesle-governed-workflow
plugins.description: Governed low-HITL workflows for complex work, repositories, and reusable skill development.
plugins.long_description: Run complex repository work with low-HITL governance and build, validate, evaluate, promote, and distribute reusable skills from one canonical catalog.
default_prompts: Use Governed Workflow to take this repository task through validation and merge with low HITL.
Use Governed Workflow to turn this project skill into a validated reusable global skill.

plugins.name: guedesle-skill-creator
plugins.description: Create, refactor, validate, evaluate, generalize, promote, and package reusable skills through a governed lifecycle.
plugins.long_description: Turn a workflow, project skill, or skill idea into a validated reusable skill with authoring, evals, portability audit, promotion, repository gates, and local packaging.
default_prompts: Create a reusable skill from this workflow and take it through authoring, validation, evaluation, portability, promotion, and local packaging.
Audit this project-specific skill for portability and turn it into a validated reusable skill.

plugins.name: guedesle-writing
plugins.description: Plan, architect, draft, refactor, evidence-check, calibrate, and review writing through a coordinated editorial workflow.
plugins.long_description: Take writing from purpose and structure through paragraphs, evidence, technical drafting, rhetoric, accessibility, editorial QA, and alignment without forcing unnecessary stages.
default_prompts: Use Writing to turn these notes and sources into a structured, evidence-aware, polished document.
Use Writing to restructure and revise this draft, preserving facts and finishing with editorial QA.
